mentions.name: FetchText
mentions.description: This tool automates manual document workflows: a document is uploaded, an LLM extracts structured data from it, and a new document is generated from a template. It is API-first, includes webhooks, and is built to be self-hosted/self-provisioned for privacy.
mentions.problem: Accounting paperwork in industries like manufacturing is still a manual burden.
mentions.audience: Industries like manufacturing where accounting paperwork is still a manual burden
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on a tool to automate manual document workflows, specifically for industries like manufacturing where accounting paperwork is still a manual burden.

The workflow: Upload doc → LLM extracts structured data → Generate new doc from template.

mentions.name: FetchText
mentions.description: A self-hosted (or self-"provisioned") document extraction platform: upload a document, extract structured fields via LLM, and generate new documents from templates. Includes a dashboard, an API, and a webhook; currently a work in progress.
mentions.problem: Manual document extraction and manipulation, particularly from accounting documents, was a large burden at the manufacturing companies the author worked with.
mentions.audience: Businesses; the author is making it flexible so businesses can use it, drawing on experience with manufacturing companies.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The goal is upload a document → extract structured fields via LLM → generate new documents from templates. Has a dashboard, with an API, along with a webhook, very much a WIP.
